test_population: previously selected label-blind fresh official Adult test records, including natural missingness; audit must pass first
train_injection: original 3520/880 partition injections, seeds seed and seed+300, unchanged R.inject
test_injection_seed: seed + 600 + int(rate*100), via unchanged corrupt helper
preprocessing: unchanged V3.2 numeric SimpleImputer(median,add_indicator=True)+StandardScaler; OneHotEncoder; 6 original numeric missing indicators
selection: mean inner validation F1; first candidate wins exact ties; each version identical 18 inner fits
final_fit: refit selected classifier on all 4400 training rows; no external label used
metric: 100 * (F1_J - F1_raw); mean of five full-precision paired gains; sample SD ddof=1
public_data_policy: no real income values, injected truth masks, labelled test data or per-record test predictions in public release
